description: Use when you need sentiment analysis, text sentiment or opinion mining of reviews, comments or headlines in English. Do not use for neutral or emotion labels, non-English text or aspect-level sentiment. Returns JSON with sentiment analysis of English text: a positive or negative label with a confidence score, from DistilBERT SST-2 on Workers AI, for one text or a batch of up to 20 for 0.004 USDC per call. Typical response time 1500 ms (p95). Category: Inference.

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

text.description: One English text to classify, e.g. The checkout was fast (up to 2000 characters)

texts.description: Or a batch of up to 20 English texts, e.g. ["Great support", "Broken on arrival"]

name: blackwood_text_sentiment

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: Sentiment analysis
